description: Authoritative Granblue Fantasy Raid Evaluation and Join Decision Catalog, providing dynamic Leech vs Racing heuristics, Time-to-Death (TTD) velocity estimation, and EP Return-on-Investment (ROI) rules.

actionPolicies.description: Abort raid join. Boss HP is too low (< 5%) or Time-to-Death is under 10 seconds; loading into battle will result in empty room or zero honor payout, wasting EP and locking an assist slot.
Join immediately for fast 1-button burst or Quick Summon. Target HP is between 5% and 35% with active room clearing pace. Yields instant drop rolls with minimal time investment.
Engage high-performance racing rotation. Boss HP is between 30% and 85% with sufficient runway to secure 100% blue chest probability threshold.
Skip raid. Room has only 1-2 participants with high HP remaining and long elapsed time (> 10 minutes), representing an abandoned or failed raid that would trap EP indefinitely.
Skip raid. Room participant count is >= 29/30; high risk of failing HTTP join handshake due to concurrent incoming joins.

raidProfiles.name: Prototype Bahamut HL (Wings of Terror)
raidProfiles.tacticalNotes: Deploy Dark Burst or Fire Burst; focus on hitting 1.48M honors before 25% phase.

raidProfiles.name: Akasha HL (Omen of the Broken Skies)
raidProfiles.primaryDrop: Gold Brick (1.2% in Blue Chest), Hollowsky Key
raidProfiles.tacticalNotes: Turn acceleration mechanics mean buff durations deplete quickly; favor instant strike skills.

raidProfiles.name: Grand Order HL (The Peacemaker's Wings)
raidProfiles.primaryDrop: Gold Brick (1.2% in Blue Chest), Heavenly Horn
raidProfiles.tacticalNotes: Peacemaker field buffs player ATK and cap; deal maximum honors before 50% form change.

raidProfiles.name: Tiamat Aura Omega (Magna 3)
raidProfiles.tacticalNotes: Rapid leeching via Turn 1 Agni/Beelzebub burst for gold chest and participation animas.

raidProfiles.name: Colossus Ira Omega (Magna 3)
raidProfiles.tacticalNotes: Varuna/Kengo burst for instant water leech; beware Turn 1 Repel/Cut omens.

raidProfiles.name: Wilnas (Six Dragons Impossible)
raidProfiles.tacticalNotes: Quick water burst; avoid prolonged combat without Dispel.

raidProfiles.name: Siete (Revans)
raidProfiles.tacticalNotes: Requires dedicated Fire Kengo or Paladin setup. Leeching forbidden due to high raid failure rate.

raidProfiles.name: Super Ultimate Bahamut
raidProfiles.tacticalNotes: Host with Ascendant Prayer or dedicated coordinated co-op room only.
